title: CI name does not follow the naming standard
cardHint: The name does not end as the instruction asks for its class, for example _BS. The owner corrects it in EPO.
cardText: The instruction gives each class an ending: a Business Service ends with _BS, a Service Instance with " - PROD" or " - TEST". The owner is asked to correct the name in EPO. The name of a Business Application is on Application ≠ Instance: SACM copies it from its Service Instance.

message.subject: Name not standard
message.intro: Their name does not follow the SACM naming standard.
message.ask: Please correct the name. {Reply} if you need help, or if the name is right as it is.
message.why: A standard name lets everybody find the CI and see what it is.
